name: blog-stack
docker_compose_raw:
services:
  ghost:
    image: ghost:5
    environment:
      - SERVICE_FQDN_GHOST_2368
      - database__connection__password=${SERVICE_PASSWORD_MYSQL}
  mysql:
    image: mysql:8
    environment:
      - MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${SERVICE_PASSWORD_MYSQL}
    volumes:
      - mysql-data:/var/lib/mysql
volumes:
  mysql-data: {}
